newsitem.title: USA: Hayes Wheels Intl sells $250 mln 144A debt. [CORRECTED 20:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hayes Wheels Intl sells $250 mln 144A debt. [CORRECTED 20:50 GMT]

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from Hayes Wheels International Inc was priced on Thursday via lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp, according to high-yield market sources.
The deal was increased in size by $50 million. It priced with a 9-1/8 percent coupon, which compares with preliminary price talk for a coupon of nine percent, one source said.

Hayes Wheels, an automotive wheel and brake product supplier, earlier this month said it will acquire Lemmerz Holding GmbH, a European full-line wheel supplier, in a cash and stock transaction valued at about $390 million.
